autobiographical_events.summary: I accepted North after an earlier calibration.
At tick 2 a verified independent calibration failure (C0) for the exact case led me to suspend, not reverse, my inherited support for North's determining authority.

imaginations.title: The signature that signs itself
imaginations.image_or_idea: A document whose seal is impeccable and whose contents are wrong — the wax is perfect, the claim is not.
imaginations.possible_value: Keeps authorship and reliability conceptually separate
imaginations.test_question: Does separating signature from content change any actual decision here?

imaginations.title: The motif that remembers being seen
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circle whose hue is a function of how many times it has been looked at — green to the first glance, blue to the second, so the colour is a receipt for attention.
imaginations.possible_value: Converts an undecidable aesthetic dispute into a testable claim about attention
imaginations.test_question: Do viewers prefer the second-look colour, or only the fact that it changed?
